meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (official CAS and prompted statistical reports), via the local Data Bank
meta.vintageNote: The archived RBI CAS and prompted report exports do not publish a source revision timestamp. Archive capture is recorded separately and does not establish when estimates were revised.
meta.revisionPolicy: Each quarter's figures come from the companies that reported in that quarter; growth rates compare the same companies a year apart and are final as printed.
meta.coverage: Annual results of listed non-government non-financial companies by industry: rupee totals for the companies reporting in each period.
meta.note: Direct RBI DBIE: CAS full history, newest prompted report restatements preferred. Growth compares common companies; period totals and ratios use changing samples. Amounts are not a comparable time series. CAS omits some zero or |rate| ≥150 cells; reports preserve meaningful numeric cells and quarantine the exact 999999999 sentinel. Zero-filled CAS amount vectors and rupee-valued growth are missing, never true zero. Historical duplicate-key ratios retain the inherited mirror selection with an ambiguity flag until official reports resolve them. See sourceByDate for each cell; full source defects and overlap in markets-rbi.source-quality.json.
